# braintrust_role (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Braintrust role by ID or name. A name lookup fails if multiple roles match; set `org_id` for a custom role or use the ID of a system role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the built-in system roles
data "braintrust_role" "viewer" {
  name = "Viewer"
}

data "braintrust_role" "engineer" {
  name = "Engineer"
}

data "braintrust_role" "owner" {
  name = "Owner"
}

output "viewer_role_id" {
  value = data.braintrust_role.viewer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the role (UUID). Provide either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the role to look up. Provide either `name` or `id`.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID to match for a custom role. Null for system roles.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of role creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of role deletion, or null if the role is still active.
- `description` (String) Textual description of the role.
- `member_permissions` (Attributes Set) Permissions that belong to this role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--member_permissions))
- `member_roles` (Set of String) IDs of roles this role inherits from.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the role.

<a id="nestedatt--member_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `member_permissions`

Read-Only:

- `permission` (String) The permission type.
- `restrict_object_type` (String) Optionally restricts the permission to a specific object type.
